newsitem.title: USA: MIDCOM OKs class action lawsuit settlement.
newsitem.headline: MIDCOM OKs class action lawsuit settlement.

text.p: MIDCOM Communications Inc said Thursday its board of directors has approved terms of a proposed settlement of a securities class action lawsuit related to its July 1995 initial public offering and the restatement of third quarter 1995 earnings.
Under the settlement agreement, MIDCOM'S insurer will provide a $1 million payment and MIDCOM will issue approximately 420,000 shares of common stock subject to possible adjustments.

The lawsuit had been pending against the company, the vice chairman of the board and two of its former officers. The settlement is subject to court approval, which is expected to occur in the second half of 1997.

The company also said it has concluded arbitration which set the price for the redemption of 885,360 shares of the company's common stock held by its former president and chief executive at $6.80 per share, representing a discount from the value of the shares as of the date of his resignation.
Payments will be made over a period of 36 months, commencing May 15, 1997.
